calculatorURLKind: Canonical replay URL from actual observed UI family, method, item level and three requirement IDs. Any nonfractured explicit starting mods are cleared in the replay because a chaotic fossil reroll replaces all of them.
source: Actual current public Craft of Exile calculator and ordinary paid emulator reroll; not an in-game craft or transaction.
settings: Rare Attack Damage while holding a Shield Large Cluster Jewel at exactly item level 68, unfractured, uncorrupted, uninfluenced and unsynthesised. Acquire exactly 8 passives and 2 jewel sockets. One Serrated Fossil plus one Primitive Chaotic Resonator per independent reroll. All three notables required together: Fuel the Fight, Heavy Hitter, Veteran Defender. No finishing step.

procurementConstraints.note: The calculator family header displays the unrolled8–12 passive range. It uses one Large Cluster affix pool for this damage variant. Exactly8passives and2sockets are mandatory acquisition/comparable constraints; random passives and unrelated numeric affixes are not separately targeted by this probability.

limits: Rounded analytical probability and mean consumption, not an empirical completed-item sample.
No guaranteed notable positioning, additional useful fourth modifier, Intangibility, quality or Vesper multi-outcome benefit is included.
Only the stated single-fossil route was costed; a different craft may be cheaper. Positive profitability and completed sales are not established by this model.
Current live material and eligible-base asking prices must be collected separately; CoE default currency prices and historical personal prices are not imported.
